## Problem

A clear description of the problem or limitation you're experiencing.  
e.g. "I can't export in MP3 format, only WAV..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see and how it would work.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, or examples from other tools that illustrate your idea.
